description: Search Walmart.com by keyword, browse a category shelf, open full product pages, or read customer reviews. No account, cookies or proxy setup needed.

brands.description: Only keep these brands, using Walmart's own brand filter. Enter names exactly as Walmart shows them, e.g. DEWALT.
brands.title: Brands (exact names)

categoryUrls.description: Walmart category links starting with /browse/ or /cp/ (mode = browse), e.g. https://www.walmart.com/browse/electronics/3944.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

enrichDetails.description: Open each search/browse product page to add brand, UPC, model, description, specifications, images, return policy and review breakdown. Slower and uses more requests.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich search rows with product details

excludeOutOfStock.description: Drop products Walmart marks out of stock.
excludeOutOfStock.title: Exclude out of stock

excludeSponsored.description: Drop paid/sponsored placements and keep organic search results only.
excludeSponsored.title: Exclude sponsored

facet.description: Any Walmart listing facet as type:value, e.g. retailer_type:Walmart, special_offers:Rollback, customer_rating_range_facet_new_filter_v0:4 - 5 Stars, exclude_oos:Show available items only.
facet.title: Walmart facet (advanced)

freeShippingOnly.description: Only keep products with free shipping. Search/browse rows are automatically enriched from product pages so this filter is accurate.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

itemIds.description: Walmart numeric item IDs (the number at the end of a product link), one per line (mode = products or reviews).
itemIds.title: Item IDs

maxConcurrency.description: How many product or review pages to fetch at the same time (1-10). Higher is faster but more aggressive.
maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records for the whole run. In review mode this caps review rows.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Maximum search or category pages to walk per query/URL (about 40 products per page). Walmart caps its own listing at 25 pages.
maxPages.title: Max result pages per query

maxPrice.description: Only keep products at or below this price. Applied by Walmart's own price filter.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

maxReviews.description: Maximum customer reviews to read per product in review mode. Walmart only publishes reviews that contain text.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews per product

minPrice.description: Only keep products at or above this price. Applied by Walmart's own price filter.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

minRating.description: Only keep products rated at least this (0-5). Products with no rating yet are kept.
minRating.title: Min rating

minReviewCount.description: Only keep products with at least this many reviews. Products with no review count are kept.
minReviewCount.title: Min review count

mode.description: What to scrape: keyword search, a category shelf, full product pages, or customer reviews.
enumTitles: Product details by URL or item ID
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Walmart product links (mode = products or reviews), e.g. https://www.walmart.com/ip/20042402979. Short /ip/ links and alphanumeric product IDs also work.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

reviewSort.description: How Walmart should order customer reviews.
reviewSort.title: Review order

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords to search on walmart.com (mode = search). Each query is walked page by page.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sellerContains.description: Only keep products whose seller name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. Walmart, Pro Seller.
sellerContains.title: Seller name contains

sortBy.description: Walmart listing order for search and browse modes.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Walmart Search Scraper Input
